ValidationRule.description: Prevents non-administrators from deleting line items on an Opportunity once it is Closed Won or Closed Lost.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(OR(ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Lost")), No_of_Line_Items__c < PRIORVALUE(No_of_Line_Items__c), NOT( $Setup.Application_Settings__c.Disable_Validation_Rules__c), $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Opportunity Line Items cannot be deleted because the Opportunity is closed.
